levels.surface: عبد الله بن ثعلبة بن صعير

notes: «أو قال عبد الله بن ثعلبة» names the same Companion in another form: both kept as alternatives in one level (rule 2)
«- هو ابن وائل -» and «قال محمد بن يحيى هو بكر بن وائل بن داود» are glosses: left out, and the two Bakrs are not merged (rule 9)
the second route ends at a bare «أبيه» (relation); the Prophet ends both routes
